Customer — View

This screen displays complete details for an individual customer record, including contact information, billing address, and transaction history.

Available Actions

Use the Edit button to modify customer information such as name, address, email, or phone number.

Click View to see all transactions associated with this customer, including invoices, receipts, and credit notes.

The Attach button allows you to upload and store documents related to this customer, such as contracts or correspondence.

Quick Conversion

The Copy to button provides a convenient way to create a supplier record from this customer's information. This is useful when a customer also supplies goods or services to your business.

To learn more about creating and managing customers, see: Customer — Edit
